paper_title: 1.4 Million Open-Source Distilled Reasoning Dataset to Empower Large   Language Model Training
caption: Difficulty distribution of the data entries. Most of the dataset entries are classified as Medium (51.8%) or Hard (25.7%). A smaller proportion falls into the Easy (11.2%), Very Hard (6.5%), and Very Easy (4.7%) categories.
model_annotation: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of difficulty levels within a dataset of approximately 1.4 million entries. The chart contains six distinct slices, each representing a different difficulty category: Very easy (4.7%), Very hard (6.5%), Easy (11.2%), Medium (51.8%), Hard (25.7%), and Difficulty (360,892). Percentage labels are displayed within each slice, and the segments appear ordered from smallest to largest in terms of area. A legend is not explicitly provided, but the color coding – blue for Very easy, grey for Very hard, green for Easy, red for Medium, and dark red for Hard – is utilized to differentiate the categories.
